pages.text: Smelt an iron ingot to get a $(item)Heated Ingot$(). A blast furnace is twice as fast.

Metal starts cooling once it leaves the furnace: orange, then red, then faded red, then cold. You have about 30 seconds to work it (longer as your Forging improves). Cooler metal is harder to strike: the marker sweeps faster. Cold metal goes back in the furnace with no loss.
pages.title: Cooling
